pages.text: A Salvegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a pink-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held and toggled on, the gem will heal you for half a heart approximately once every second if you are hurt. Each half heart consumes a point of charge.
To recharge a dun Salvegleam, slaughter a passive animal while holding the gem. Doing so restores points of charge equal to half of the animal's maximum health.
